name: dock-cleanup
title: Dock Cleanup
description: Drag a box over Dock icons to quit those apps and remove them from the Dock.
author: alara_martin

commands.name: dock-cleanup
commands.title: Dock Cleanup
commands.description: Start a sweep: drag a box over Dock icons, confirm, and those apps quit and leave the Dock.

preferences.name: protectedApps
preferences.title: Protected Apps
preferences.description: App names or bundle IDs a sweep never quits or removes, separated by commas.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
